title: Where Can We Find You?
verse: But he replied, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?
observation: Imagine you moved to a new city. A few months later, some friends are driving through town and they want to surprise you. As hard as it is, they don’t reach out to see where you are. Instead, they have to follow your footsteps and inquire from people you may have met. Would anyone think to go to the local churches to hear if you have been there? Would they expect that you were in your Heavenly Father’s House? We need to make God such a priority in our lives that the House of God would be the first place they would have looked.
application: Orient your life so that people know by your habits that you are pursuing God.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us the way in Your Word.
